levels.surface: محمد بن عبد، الله بن نمير

notes: two branches split by «ح»; the text's «حدثنا أبي» in branch B is Abdullah b. Numayr, the same man as branch A's second link, kept as a relation and not merged
the shared tail follows that man in both branches: Bashir, Abdullah b. Buraydah, then «أبيه» (Buraydah, Companion)
«وتقاربا في لفظ الحديث» is a remark; Ma'iz in the story is in the scene only
